items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was James Michael Curley’s announcer most of the time on his campaigns.

ctx.x: Was this the time of Mayor Curley, or who?

No, Curley was a little later. I got to know Curley when I was in radio. But at the time, the town was so anti-Semitic. She was a passionate committed Catholic and was furious at the Church because it didn’t do anything about it. So she decided to do some investigative stuff on anti-Semitism. She got some of us kids to be reporters, sort of incognito. She was, I think, all my life my main role model. She wouldn’t take any advertising. She said, “I’m the boss. They can come to me.” After a while – after we had…
Was this woman you mentioned – Sweeney – was she doing something similar to I. F. Stone in later years?
